mapper.select: SELECT u.id FROM `user` u INNER JOIN worker_staffing ws ON ws.worker_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT assignee AS worker_id, COUNT(*) AS open_tasks FROM repair_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status IN (1, 2) AND assignee IS NOT NULL GROUP BY assignee ) task_load ON task_load.worker_id = u.id WHERE u.role = 3 AND u.status = 1 AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND ws.is_deleted = 0 AND ws.current_status = 1 AND ( FIND_IN_SET(#{category}, REPLACE(ws.specialties, '，', ',')) > 0 OR REPLACE(ws.specialties, '，', ',') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{category}, '%') ) ORDER BY IFNULL(task_load.open_tasks, 0) ASC, u.id ASC LIMIT 1
